?

POSITION SUMMARY 

The HR Admin Assistant supports day-to-day human resources operations with a strong focus on 

employee records management, onboarding and offboarding, compliance, and employee services. This 

role ensures accurate and audit-ready HR documentation, administer employment verification and leave 

processes, and serves as a first point of contact for Tier-1 employee inquiries. The HR Assistant partners 

closely with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, IT, and HR leadership to ensure seamless workforce transitions, 

data integrity within HR systems, and timely payroll support. Through consistent process execution, 

reporting, and continuous improvement efforts, this role contributes to efficient HR operations and a 

positive employee experience.



ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS 



Reasonable Accommodations Statement 

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. 

Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the 

essential functions.

Essential Functions: 

Employee Records & Onboarding / Offboarding

• Maintain accurate employee e-files in accordance with naming conventions, retention schedules, 

and audit standards.

• Process employee separations, including sending exit communications, completing system 

terminations, and updating access and distribution lists.

• Partner with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and IT to ensure smooth and timely onboarding and 

offboarding handoffs.

Verification, Documentation & Compliance

• Conduct onsite I-9 verifications and reverifications; maintain compliant records and support EVerify when applicable.

• Track Employment Authorization Document (EAD) expirations, communicate deadlines, and 

escalate risks prior to lapse.

• Support HR audits and regulatory requests by maintaining audit-ready documentation.

• Administer MFP and NHO surveys, compile results, and share summaries with HR for review 

and action.



Employee Services & Case Administration

• Administer Leave of Absence intake and tracking (FMLA, state, and company leaves) in 

coordination with Benefits and Payroll, including issuance of required notices.

• Manage unemployment claims by gathering documentation, submitting timely responses, and 

maintaining claim records.

• Own HR inbox triage; resolve Tier-1 employee inquiries (policy basics, PTO routing, forms) and 

escalate complex matters to HR Business Partners.

• Process live-on-site requests in accordance with policy and document approvals or denials.

• Publish approved employee communications accurately and on schedule.

Reporting, Systems & Continuous Improvement

• Maintain data integrity within the HRIS through routine audits and timely discrepancy resolution.

• Draft and update standard operating procedures and recommend process improvements to 

improve accuracy, efficiency, and turnaround times.

HR Administration & Payroll 

• Serve as backup support for the TA Assistant role and assist with additional HR administrative 

duties as needed.

• Support payroll processing by coordinating timely and accurate data flow related to new hires, 

terminations, job changes, leaves of absence, and status updates between HRIS and Payroll.

• Assist with payroll audits by validating employee data (pay rates, deductions, employment status, 

and leave coding) and resolving discrepancies prior to payroll submission.



POSITION QUALIFICATIONS 

Competencies:

• Quality & Attention to Detail - Ensures accurate employee records, audit-ready documentation, 

compliant I-9s, and clean HRIS and payroll data.

• Accountability - Takes ownership of onboarding/offboarding tasks, compliance tracking, case 

follow-through, and timely completion of HR and payroll support activities.

• Communication - Effectively manages Tier-1 employee inquiries, coordinates with Payroll, TA, 

IT, and HRBPs, and communicates deadlines and requirements clearly.

• Planning & Organization - Manages multiple HR workflows simultaneously, including 

employee records, leave administration, audits, surveys, and payroll coordination.

• Safety & Compliance - Supports legal and regulatory requirements such as I-9 verification, EAD 

tracking, LOA compliance, unemployment claims, and audit readiness.

Qualifications 

Experience

• Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent; 2+ years of HR experience in HR operations or 

generalist support. 

• Preferred: BA/BS. 

• Working knowledge of HRIS (e.g., Paylocity/Workday), document management, and

ticketing/inbox tools. 

• Familiarity with I?9, EAD, FMLA/LOA basics, unemployment processes, and records retention. 

• Proven discretion with confidential information; excellent organization and follow?through

title: EOS Implementor/ coach
description:
# Part-Time EOS Implementer / Level 10 Meeting Facilitator



## About The Opportunity



We are a new startup company in the property management and real estate services space looking to begin implementing elements of the EOS® (Entrepreneurial Operating System®) framework popularized by Gino Wickman’s book *Traction*.



At this stage, we are intentionally taking a light and practical approach to EOS implementation. We do not currently have the bandwidth to fully implement every aspect of the system over the next several months, but we strongly believe in the accountability, structure, and operational clarity EOS can provide.



We are looking for an experienced EOS-minded professional to help us establish consistency and operational discipline during this early growth phase.



---



## Position Overview



This is a very part-time role to start — likely only 2-3 hours per week.



We already have some foundational EOS components in place, including:



* A drafted VTO (Vision/Traction Organizer)

* Leadership structure discussions

* Early operational systems planning



Your primary role would be helping facilitate our weekly Level 10 Meetings while also providing light accountability follow-up during the week to ensure action items and priorities remain on track.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping entrepreneurial companies implement operational structure without requiring a full-scale consulting engagement.



There may be potential for a larger long-term role toward the end of this year or early next year as the company continues developing.



---



## Responsibilities



* Facilitate weekly EOS-style Level 10 Meetings

* Help keep meetings structured, productive, and focused

* Assist leadership with accountability tracking

* Follow up on Rocks and weekly to-dos

* Help identify operational bottlenecks and organizational blind spots

* Provide practical guidance on phased EOS implementation

* Learn the basics of our company structure and operational goals



---



## Requirements



* Direct experience with EOS / Traction systems

* Strong familiarity with Gino Wickman’s *Traction*

* Experience facilitating Level 10 Meetings

* Strong organizational and communication skills

* Ability to keep entrepreneurial leadership teams focused and accountable

* Previous EOS Integrator, EOS Implementer, Operations Consultant, or business coaching experience is strongly preferred



---



## Important Notes



This is NOT currently a full EOS implementation engagement.



For the next 6 months, the focus is primarily on:



* Weekly accountability

* Leadership alignment

* Maintaining traction on priorities

* Building operational consistency

* Creating structure gradually and realistically



We are looking for somebody practical, organized, experienced with EOS principles, and comfortable working with an entrepreneurial startup environment.



---



## To Apply



Please provide:



* Your EOS experience

* Companies or teams you’ve worked with

* Your experience facilitating Level 10 Meetings

* Your approximate weekly availability

* Your hourly or project-based rate



Experience working with service-based businesses is considered an asset.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller — Multi-Brand Consumer Operator



About the Role



We are a multi-brand consumer operator with retail (Target), DTC, TikTok Shop, Amazon, and wholesale channels. We are hiring a full-time, remote Financial Controller based in the Philippines to own the financial operating system across our brands. This role reports directly to the founder and is the financial backbone of the business.



You will not be negotiating with vendors, retailers, or lenders. You will be the source of truth for what we spent, what we made, what we owe, and what we have, and you will build the reports that let us make decisions fast.



---



What You Will Own



Financial Model and Reporting

- Maintain a rolling financial model covering DTC, TikTok Shop, Amazon, wholesale, and any new channels we launch

- Daily true profit report from the prior day, by channel and SKU

- Weekly KPI snapshot for the founder: cash, MER, channel contribution margin, inventory weeks on hand

- Monthly P&L with variance commentary against the model

- Gross-to-net revenue reporting after discounts, returns, chargebacks, and platform fees



Cash and Working Capital

- 13-week rolling cash flow forecast

- AP and AR aging with active collections from wholesale buyers

- Vendor payment scheduling against cash availability

- Management of loans, lines of credit, and factor financing facilities



Inventory and COGS

- SKU-level landed COGS (product, freight, duties, inbound 3PL)

- Inventory forecasting against demand by channel

- Per-channel and per-SKU contribution margin

- Standard vs actual cost variance

- Gifting and sample inventory reconciliation so units leaving for marketing do not look like shrinkage



Marketplace and Channel Reconciliation

- Amazon Seller Central settlement reconciliation (fees, FBA, returns, reserves)

- TikTok Shop payout reconciliation

- Shopify payout to GL matching

- Refund and return reserves by channel

- Retail deductions and chargebacks: track, categorize, and queue disputes for the ops team to file



Marketing Spend Reporting

- Daily ad spend pulled fro
ta, TikTok, Google, and Amazon Ads into the model

- Reconcile platform-reported spend against credit card statements

- Track agency fees separately from working media so we see real working vs non-working spend

- Affiliate and creator commission tracking (LTK, ShareASale, TikTok Shop affiliate, custom codes)

- SaaS spend categorization and a renewal calendar so nothing auto-renews unnoticed



Influencer and Gifting

- Track contracted deliverables against payments to creators

- 1099 tracking for US creators paid over $600 per year

- Usage rights renewal calendar so we do not run ads with expired licenses

- Gifting cost tracking: product COGS, shipping, and a gifting CAC against attributable revenue or earned content value

- 1099 implications for high-value product gifts to a single creator



Close, Books, and Compliance

- 10-day month-end close

- Bank and credit card reconciliations

- Inventory accounting and COGS journal entries

- Multi-state sales tax compliance (TikTok Shop and DTC create nexus exposure quickly)

- Year-end 1099 preparation

- Clean books hand-off to our US CPA at year end



---



Requirements



- 5+ years of accounting or finance experience

- 2+ years working with a US-based company

- QuickBooks Online proficiency (NetSuite is a plus)

- Experience with A2X, Settle, or a similar marketplace reconciliation tool

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel modeling skills

- Working knowledge of US GAAP

- Clear written English, comfortable on async Slack and weekly Zoom calls

- Able to walk us through how you would reconcile an Amazon settlement or dispute a Target deduction



Bonus Points



- Prior CPG, beauty, or food and beverage clients

- Familiarity with Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center, and Amazon Seller Central

- Experience with Triple Whale, Northbeam, or a similar analytics platform

- Multi-entity accounting experience



---



Out of Scope



- Negotiating with vendors, retailers, or lenders

- Tax filing (handled by our US CPA)

- HR and payroll administration



Logistics



- Full-time, remote, Philippines-based

- Overlap of at least 3 hours with US Pacific Time

- Direct reporting to the founders



---



How to Apply



Send a short note covering:



1. A brand or company whose books you currently or recently owned, with one paragraph on their financial complexity

2. Your experience with marketplace reconciliation (Amazon, TikTok Shop, or Shopify)

3. The largest financial model you have built and what it covered

4. Your available start date and target monthly rate in USD

description:
About the Role

Blue Moon Fitness is a four-location health club chain based in Omaha, Nebraska. We process payroll twice a month and need a reliable, detail-oriented specialist to handle the data entry portion of that process.

This is a small but critical job. You will receive a package of reports, enter the data accurately into our payroll spreadsheets, and return the completed files — all within a firm deadline. That's it.

Estimated time commitment: 3–6 hours, twice per month.

What You’ll Do

Each pay period you will receive:

• Homebase timesheet exports (regular hours, overtime, and sick pay) for four locations

• ABC Datatrak activity reports (Events, PT Sales, and Concierge)



You will take that data and accurately populate our Asure payroll eSheets for each location — including hours and commission/bonus columns — then return the completed files before the deadline.

What We’re Looking For

This job is simple. What makes it hard is doing it perfectly, every time.

We are looking for someone who:

• Meets deadlines without exception. When we give you a due date, we mean it. Payroll is time-sensitive and the every employee depends on accuracy.

• Is detail-obsessed. You will be entering numbers that affect people’s paychecks. Errors are not acceptable.

• Communicates proactively. If something looks wrong, you flag it. If you have a question, you ask it before the deadline — not after.

• Shows up reliably. This is not a big job, but it is a consistent one. We need someone we can count on every single pay period.

• Is trustworthy. You will be handling sensitive payroll data. We take confidentiality seriously and expect the same from everyone we work with.



Requirements

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel (data entry, navigating multi-column spreadsheets)

• Strong attention to detail — you must be able to cross-reference data across multiple source files

• Reliable internet connection and ability to receive and return files via

• Available to complete work within 24–48 hours of receiving the file package

• English communication skills sufficient for
 correspondence



Nice to Have

• Experience with ABC Financial Datatrak and Homebase

• Experience with payroll data entry or HR administration

• Familiarity with fitness industry or multi-location businesses

• Experience working with U.S.-based employers



How to Apply

Please respond with:

• A brief description of any data entry or payroll-related work you have done

• Your rate expectation



Applications that do not include all three items will not be considered.

We are straightforward to work with. We respect your time, we pay on time, and we give clear instructions. In return, we expect the same professionalism.

title: GHL Specialist - Customer Support
description:
Stri CRM is a fast-growing SaaS company serving land investors with an all-in-one CRM platform built on GoHighLevel. We launched in April 2025 and are approaching 150 users. We are scaling rapidly with ambitious growth goals.



Our tech stack includes:

- GoHighLevel (core platform)

- AI integrations (Sales Coach product)

- Automation workflows

- API integrations

- Custom snapshot configurations

- Third-party tools (Marketers Toolkit, HL Pro Tools, project management plugins)



The Role

We need a GoHighLevel power user who can take ownership of our platform's technical infrastructure. This is not a "set it and forget it" role; you'll be actively building, troubleshooting, optimizing, and innovating within GHL daily.



What You'll Own:

- Automation & Workflows

- Design and implement complex multi-step automation sequences

- Build follow-up campaigns, lead nurturing workflows, and customer lifecycle automations

- Troubleshoot broken workflows and optimize existing automations

- Create automation documentation for team reference

- Configure and maintain API connections

- Set up webhooks for third-party integrations

- Integrate external tools (skip tracing, AI systems, project management)

- Platform Management

- Configure forms, surveys, and website elements

- Feature Implementation

- Roll out new GHL features to users (global search, project management, Marketers Toolkit)

- Embed and organize apps within folder structures

- Configure user permissions and access controls

- Test new features before company-wide deployment

- Customer Support & Documentation

- Troubleshoot customer issues within GHL

- Create Loom tutorials for common workflows

- Maintain internal documentation of system architecture

- Train tea
mbers on new features and processes



Must-Have Skills

- GoHighLevel Expertise (Required)

- 2+ years hands-on GHL experience - we need someone who has lived in this platform

- Deep understanding of GHL's automation builder (triggers, conditions, actions, delays)

- Experience managing multi-location setups or white-label configurations

- Strong knowledge of GHL's contact/opportunity management

- Familiarity with GHL's form builder, website builder, and funnel system

- Understanding of GHL pricing tiers and feature limitations



Technical Skills (Required)

- API & Webhook experience - you should be comfortable reading API documentation and configuring endpoints

- Basic understanding of JSON and how data structures work

- Experience with third-party integrations via Zapier, 
, or native connections

- Troubleshooting mindset - able to diagnose why automations break



Bonus Skills (Highly Valued)

- n8n experience - this is a significant advantage as we're exploring workflow automation outside GHL

- Understanding of Airtable or similar database tools

- Experience with AI integrations (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.)

- Familiarity with land investing/real estate CRM workflows

- Experience building custom apps or plugins for GHL

- Basic HTML/CSS for GHL page customization



Who You Are

- Self-directed problem-solver - You don't need hand-holding. If something breaks, you investigate, test solutions, and fix it.

- Documentation-oriented - You naturally document your work because you understand that systems need to be maintainable by others.

- Detail-obsessed - You test your automations thoroughly. You think about edge cases. You double-check your work.

- Communication-strong - This is a customer-facing role. You will be expected to hop on calls with users to troubleshoot issues, walk through systems, and explain solutions. Strong English communication, both written and verbal, is required. You should be comfortable speaking clearly, guiding conversations, and representing the company professionally.

- Growth-minded - You stay current with GHL updates, watch platform training, and continuously improve your skills.

- Reliable & responsive - We're in different time zones, but you're consistently available, hit deadlines, and communicate proactively.



This role is NOT for you if:

- You've only built basic funnels and haven't touched workflows

- You freeze up when things don't work as expected

- You need constant direction on what to do next

- You're intimidated by APIs, webhooks, or technical documentation



Compensation & Growth

- Starting: $5-6/hour depending on experience (we're looking for quality over cost)

- Schedule: Part-time (15-25 hours/week) with a rapid path to full-time (40 hours/week) for strong performers



Growth path:

- We're scaling fast and need to build a technical team

- Proven performers can move into senior/lead roles as we grow

- We value skill development—if you want to learn something new that helps the business, we'll support it



Working hours:

- US Eastern Time for team collaboration

- Async-friendly environment (we document heavily)



Application Process

DO NOT APPLY THROUGH GENERIC PORTALS

Instead, complete this technical screening test to demonstrate your skills:



TECHNICAL SCREENING TEST (REQUIRED)

Your Mission: Build a specific automation workflow in a test GHL account, then document your process.



Test Setup:

Create a free GHL trial account (or use your existing one)

Build the following workflow:

Scenario: A land-investing company wants to automatically follow up with leads who complete a "Property Information Request" form but don't respond within 3 days.



Required Workflow:

- Trigger: Contact fills out "Property Info Form"

- Action: Tag contact as "Info Requested"

- Action: Send immediate
 confirmation

- Wait: 3 days

- Condition: Check if contact replied to
 OR filled out second form

- If YES: Tag "Engaged" and end workflow

- If NO: Continue to step 6

- Action: Send SMS reminder

- Wait: 2 days

- Condition: Check if contact engaged

- If YES: Tag "Engaged" and end workflow

- If NO: Continue to step 9

- Action: Create task for sales team "Cold lead - manual outreach needed"

- Action: Move contact to "Requires Attention" pipeline stage



Deliverables:

1. Record a Loom video (10-15 minutes max) showing:

2. Your completed workflow (show the automation builder)

3. A quick walkthrough of each step explaining WHY you configured it that way

4. A test run showing it working (or explain how you'd test it)

5. One improvement you'd make to this workflow if you had more time



Also provide:

1. Screenshot of your completed automation

2. Brief written explanation (3-5 sentences) of one challenge you encountered

3. Your answer to this question: "If the SMS step was failing for some contacts but not others, what are 3 things you'd check to troubleshoot?"



Submission:

Send your Loom link + documents:



Why This Test? This test shows us:

- You actually know GHL (many people claim expertise but can't build basic workflows)

- Your problem-solving process and attention to detail

- How you communicate technical concepts

- Whether you can follow instructions precisely

- Your documentation skills (critical for remote work)

- Timeline: We review submissions within 24 hours. Strong candidates will be invited to a 30-minute technical interview where we'll dig deeper into your GHL experience.



About Our Team

We're a small, remote-first team that values:

- Ownership: We trust people to own their domain

- Documentation: If it's not documented, it doesn't exist

- Async communication: We use Slack, Loom, and Notion heavily

- Continuous improvement: We're always iterating and optimizing

- Customer obsession: Everything we build is in service of land investor success



Our culture:

- No micromanagement - we hire adults and treat them like adults

- Regular team offsites (we just did Philippines in Dec 2025)

- Open feedback loops - we want to hear your ideas

- Work-life balance matters - we're building for the long term



FAQ

Q: Can I work from anywhere? A: Yes, fully remote. Must have reliable internet and ability to overlap with US Eastern Time for key meetings.

Q: What if I don't have n8n experience? A: Still apply if you're strong in GHL + APIs. We can train on n8n if you have the technical foundation.

Q: How quickly can this go full-time? A: For exceptional candidates, within 4-8 weeks. We're growing fast and need to scale the team.

Q: Will I get a company GHL account to practice? A: After you're hired, yes. For the test, please use a trial account.



Ready to Apply?

Remember: Do NOT send a resume through a job portal. Complete the technical test and
 us your Loom video + responses.



What happens next:

- You submit test ? We review within 24 hours

- Strong candidates ? 30-min technical interview

- Finalists ? Paid trial project (3-5 hours, ~$50)

- Best fit ? Job offer with immediate start



We're excited to find someone who can help us scale Stri to 1,000+ users in 2026. If you're a GHL wizard who thrives on solving complex automation challenges, we want to hear from you.

title: Operations Coordinator / Virtual Assistant (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
Role Overview

This is not a task-list role. We are looking for a self-directed operations coordinator who takes ownership of a short-term rental property and a personal operations portfolio — and runs both with minimal oversight.



You will manage two domains: (1) full-cycle operations for a high-performing Airbnb property in St. Pete, FL, and (2) personal administrative and logistics support for a senior finance executive. Both areas require independent judgment, proactive decision-making, and a system-builder mindset.



The right candidate thinks in systems, not tasks. You will be expected to identify issues before they escalate, improve the processes you inherit, and operate as though you are accountable for outcomes — not just completion of instructions.



Schedule & Availability

This role is outcome-based, not time-based. There are no fixed office hours.



You manage your own schedule around the operational rhythm of the property: guest check-ins and checkouts, cleaner schedules, vendor visits, and maintenance windows. Most active operational days are Sundays (primary turn day) and Mondays. Midweek days are typically lighter.



• Estimated commitment: 20 hours/week (part-time)

• You must be available and responsive during Eastern Time business hours, especially on turn days

• Urgent situations — guest-impacting issues, cleaner no-shows, maintenance emergencies — require same-day response regardless of day or hour

• Communication with the owner is via WhatsApp for approvals and escalations; response expected within 2 hours during ET business hours



Part 1: Property Operations

What You Own

You are the operational owner of the property between guest stays and throughout each turnover cycle. The goal is a property that runs without owner intervention except for true exceptions.



• Own the full turnover cycle end-to-end: confirm cleaner arrival after checkout, verify no visible damage immediately, review cleaning photos same day (or flag as non-urgent if no guest impact)

• Prioritize issues by urgency: same-day guest impact = handle immediately; non-guest-impacting = next-day resolution acceptable

• Maintain a master operations calendar covering guest stays, cleaner schedules, vendor visits, pool service, landscaper dates, maintenance appointments, and delivery windows — with completion notes and issue flags

• Monitor the Airbnb calendar daily for new bookings; schedule cleaning with the appropriate company and note same-day turn status explicitly

• Coordinate two cleaning vendors (primary and backup); manage scheduling, photo review, feedback, and escalation

• Review before/after cleaning photos for quality; follow up the same day if photos are missing or issues are visible

• Monitor the supply request log; place Instacart (Costco) and Amazon orders proactively — do not wait for items to run out

• Monitor all smart home systems weekly: Schlage locks, Ring cameras, Honeywell thermostat, Raymote pool heater

• Handle all routine guest communication via Hospitable; use AI-assisted drafts as a starting point; escalate non-standard situations to owner with a recommended response

• Manage pool heat requests end-to-end: confirm payment, activate via Raymote, maintain temperature within defined limits

• Send a Monday weekly operations update every week by 10:00 AM ET



Revenue Awareness

This role includes a revenue support dimension. You are not in sales — but you are expected to recognize and act on straightforward opportunities within defined rules.



• Identify adjacent open nights next to existing reservations and proactively reach out to guests with a 15% discount offer

• Manage early check-in and late checkout requests as revenue line items, not just scheduling decisions

• Flag recurring patterns in guest behavior or requests that may indicate pricing, listing, or process improvements

• Support execution of simple revenue optimizations as directed by the owner



Maintenance Coordination

• Classify every issue as urgent (same-day guest impact) or non-urgent (next-day or scheduled resolution)

• Urgent issues: use fast-response vendors (Thumbtack) and escalate to owner simultaneously

• Non-urgent issues: gather 2–3 quotes from licensed, highly-rated vendors; present a clear recommendation with reasoning

• Log all maintenance items with status, vendor, quote, and resolution date



Part 2: Personal Operations

You act as a Personal Operations Manager for the principal — not a reactive inbox monitor. This means managing administrative tasks end-to-end, following up without being asked, and keeping every open loop organized and moving toward resolution.



• Own all open loops: track deadlines, follow-ups, and pending items in a shared tracker with owners and due dates

• Follow up with service providers, lawyers, bill disputes, and administrative items without waiting for a reminder

• Handle life logistics: appointments, scheduling, calls, research, and coordination

• Organize Google Drive and all documents per established structure; file receipts and correspondence immediately

• Draft communications for owner review; handle routine vendor and administrative correspondence independently

• Research and shortlist vendors or options with structured summaries ready for a decision

• Prepare briefing notes or agendas as needed



System Building

This is a system-building role, not just an execution role. We expect the person in this position to leave the operation more organized and more transferable than they found it.



• Maintain and continuously improve the operations SOP — update it when processes change, when edge cases arise, or when a better approach is identified

• Document workflows clearly enough that a future coordinator could take over with minimal transition time

• Organize all systems, trackers, and files so that nothing lives only in your head

• Propose process improvements proactively; flag inefficiencies when you see them



What Success Looks Like

We define success clearly. After 30 days, you should be operating fully independently. After 90 days, the standard is:



Area Standard

Property operations Property runs without owner intervention. No missed turnovers, no unresolved guest issues, no gaps in photo review or supply management.

Communication Owner receives a Monday update every week. Escalations are infrequent, well-contextualized, and come with a recommended solution.

Systems Master tracker is accurate and current. SOP reflects how things actually work. Drive is organized. Nothing falls through the cracks.

Revenue support Upsell opportunities are identified and acted on consistently. Add-on payments are collected and logged correctly.

title: Instagram Growth Manager
description:
Instagram Growth & Content Operator



About the role



I'm hiring one person to run the content side of my Instagram account and grow it organically through content only, no bots, no shortcuts. 



This is a hands-on operator role, not an agency contract. 

You'll be working directly with me through Slack.



What you'll be doing

Effectively, you run the account. I film. You handle everything else:



Bringing content ideas to the table

Hunting outliers in my niche and adjacent niches, and feeding back what's working and why

Scripting content for my audience

Editing the raw footage I send you, using the Instagram Edits app and CapCut

Writing the captions

Scheduling posts across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, TikTok and LinkedIn

Reviewing the data weekly and adjusting the plan to keep follower and engagement growth moving in the right direction



I want to film the videos and trust that the rest is being handled properly.



Who I'm looking for:



Someone who has personally grown Instagram profiles before — to the point where you can lead me, not the other way round. I don't want to be telling you what to post, when to post, or what's working. I want you telling me, based on what you've already done for other accounts.

If you need detailed instructions to function, this isn't the role for you. You must lead this project and be proactive. 





Growth opportunity:



This starts as a solo operator role. As the account grows and you prove yourself, you'll have the option to lead a team underneath you, taking on the lower-skilled tasks while you focus on strategy and direction.



Requirements:



Proven track record of organic Instagram growth across multiple accounts or roles (must be your own work, with verifiable proof)

Able to lead the strategy, not just execute on instructions

Strong eye for outlier content across niches

Skilled at editing short-form video in the Instagram Edits app and CapCut (captions, cuts, pacing, hooks, retention edits)

Confident scripting and writing captions for a defined audience

Comfortable scheduling and managing content across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, TikTok and LinkedIn

Confident reading and acting on Instagram analytics

Available to work consistently — this is daily content, not weekly

Comfortable communicating daily through Slack

Strong written and spoken English



How to apply:



Do NOT send a CV. Do NOT send a written cover letter. Do NOT send a portfolio. - anybody who does will not be successful in in applying for this role.



In your message, include:



*Links to at least two Instagram accounts you have personally grown — accounts I can check for myself

*The starting follower count and current follower count for each, plus the time frame

*Your specific role on each account (what you did, what you didn't do)

*Links to short-form videos you have personally edited

*Confirmation you can work in the Instagram Edits app and CapCut, and communicate daily through Slack



Start your message with the word SOPRANOS as the first word, so I know you read the listing in full.



Applications without verifiable account links will not be reviewed. 



Applications with a CV attached will not be reviewed and Template responses will not be reviewed.

title: Engineering Manager (Delivery & Execution)
description:
We are seeking an Engineering manager who can own predictable delivery across engineering by enforcing sprint discipline, decision clarity, and execution standards. Reduce coordination cost, eliminate rework, and ensure that engineering output is reviewable, shippable, and on time.



Core Responsibilities



Sprint Ownership & Delivery Control

• Own sprint planning, execution, and closure

• Enforce sprint scope boundaries (no silent mid-sprint additions)

• Ensure all tickets entering a sprint meet Definition of Ready

• Track and act on: ticket aging, spillover, churn, blocked work

• Move tickets aggressively across states (TODO ? IN PROGRESS ? REVIEW ? DONE)

• Kill zombie tickets



Timebox Enforcement

• Treat timeboxes as coordination contracts, not estimates

• Require proactive communication before a timebox slips

• Block review if timebox standards are violated

• Escalate early, not after the fact



Execution Quality Gates

• Enforce: Definition of Ready (before sprint), Definition of Done (before release)

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure code review happens before QA

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Enforce agreed standards consistently: no duplication without approval, no implicit architecture decisions, no skipping ticket states

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

• Track repeat violations and escalate



Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Strong judgment around delivery tradeoffs

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

• Ability to stop work and force alignment

• Low tolerance for ambiguity in execution

• Bias for early escalation over late heroics

• Calm under pressure, emotionally neutral

• Experience running sprints that actually ship

• Strong English language skills

• Familiarity with Jira-style workflows



Nice to Have

• Background as senior engineer

• Experience in SaaS / platform teams

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a heavy-hitting AppFolio Systems Expert.  This isn’t about maintaining the status quo; it’s about rebuilding, refining, and future-proofing our operations. If you are a master  in APPFOLIO of things like database architecture, workflow redesign, automation, and the new frontier of AppFolio Stack AI, we want to talk to you.

System Audit & Calibration: Conduct a deep-dive "health check" of our current AppFolio environment. Identify bottlenecks, "ghost" data, and configuration gaps.

Data Integrity: Lead a comprehensive database cleansing initiative to ensure our reporting is 100% reliable.



AI Integration: Oversee the implementation and optimization of AppFolio’s AI enhancements, and out GEMINI also -  to drive massive efficiency gains.



The Ideal Candidate

AppFolio Power User: You have years of experience under the hood of AppFolio (Plus or Enterprise level).



Analytical Mindset: You don't just see numbers; you see the story they tell and the workflows that created them.



Strategic Thinker: You can translate complex business needs into technical configurations.



Accounting Fluency: You understand the downstream impact of system changes on trust accounting and financial reporting.



Commitment: 40 Hours per week.



Environment: Remote | Results-Oriented | Tech-Forward.

title: Senior Amazon Specialist
description:
Senior Amazon Operations Specialist

Company: Velomix 



Job Overview



We are looking for a Senior Amazon Operations Specialist to join Velomix and take ownership of our day-to-day Amazon engine. Velomix is a high-performance, innovation-driven fitness brand and the #1 best-selling protein shaker brand on Amazon US, now expanding into supplements and digital products.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who already knows Amazon inside out and wants to own results — not wait for step-by-step instructions.



Key Responsibilities

• Own daily Seller Central operations across marketplaces (US first; CA/EU as needed): listings, variations, catalog hygiene, account health, and policy compliance.

• Lead problem-solving on critical issues: suppressions, NCX, stranded/inactive SKUs, voice-of-customer, buy box, listing changes, hijackers, etc.

• Coordinate with the inventory/supply-chain team on FBA/AWD shipments, restock plans, and stock-out risk; maintain clear reorder and launch calendars.

• Manage and improve listing quality: images, copy, A+ content, brand store, and keywords — working with design, content, and PPC teams.

• Monitor performance and spot opportunities: sessions, CVR, CTR, TACoS inputs, SQP, pricing, and promo calendar.

• Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and dashboards so the system runs smoothly and can be delegated to junior tea
mbers.

• Mentor and quality-check work of Junior Amazon Specialists and VAs.

• Drive and report weekly: key metrics, issues, root causes, and proposed fixes.



Skills & Experience

• 2+ years managing Amazon Seller Central for private label brands (PL model) with a strong track record in operations and catalog management.

• Deep familiarity with tools like Helium 10, Keepa, Sellerboard, and Amazon Business Reports; strong skills in Google Sheets/Excel.

• Confident handling: listing creation/variation, flat files, cases with Seller Support, FBA/AWD workflow, and account health.

• Data-driven mindset: able to pull numbers, interpret them, and turn them into clear actions.

• Excellent written and spoken English (upper-intermediate or higher).

• Fast, reliable internet and a solid laptop suitable for daily Amazon work.

• Personality: ownership-driven, proactive, low-ego, comfortable working remotely with minimal micromanagement.



Why Join Velomix?

• Work at a fast-growing, data-driven brand with real category leadership on Amazon.

• Senior role with clear impact on revenue, profit, and customer experience.

• Competitive salary, with growth based on performance and ownership.

• Remote work with flexible hours, collaborating with a global team.



How to Apply

?? Only applications submitted via the form with a video will be considered.

?? VIDEO RECORDING IS REQUIRED. Applicants who do not submit a video recording will NOT progress to the Initial Interview, regardless of qualifications. No exceptions.



Application Form: 



To apply, complete the following steps:

1. Fill out the application form with your basic info and Amazon experience.

2. Record a video using Loom or any other recording platform (e.g., Zoom, Vidyard, screen recorder) answering the three questions below.

3. Include your video link in the form and submit.



?? Please note: A video submission is a mandatory part of the application process. Applications without a video recording will be automatically disqualified and will not move forward to the Initial Interview.

For link issues,
: 



Video Questions

Answer all three questions in your video recording.

Question 1 — Account Management & Problem Solving

Walk me through how you manage a typical day inside Amazon Seller Central.

Can you share a specific example where you identified and resolved a critical issue (such as listing suppression, stranded inventory, or account health risk)? What steps did you take and what was the outcome?



Question 2 — Data-Driven Growth

Explain how you use data to improve product performance on Amazon.

Which key metrics do you prioritize (e.g., conversion rate, CTR, TACoS), and can you give a real example of how your analysis led to a measurable improvement in sales or profitability?



Question 3 — Scaling & Strategy

If you were given a top-selling product that has plateaued, how would you scale it further?

Please outline your approach across listing optimization, PPC, pricing, and inventory management.

title: Video & Static Ad Editor
description:
MySweetSmile is an eight-figure DTC oral care brand trusted by over one million customers across the UK, US, and EU. We're hiring an AI Video & Static Editor to join our creative team and produce high-volume, high-quality creative across every brand surface — Meta ads first, with additional work spanning website image galleries, Amazon A+ Content, and other brand design touchpoints.



This is a hands-on production role. You'll receive briefs from the Creative Team, generate AI clips and statics on Higgsfield, edit and assemble in CapCut, and deliver polished, conversion-ready work every single day.



We work entirely on Higgsfield — so deep, daily fluency with their video and image generation tools is non-negotiable.



What You'll Be Doing



AI Video Generation on Higgsfield. Generate UGC-style clips, B-roll, talking heads, and product demos from supplied briefs using Higgsfield's current video models (Seedance, Veo, Kling families). Apply character locks, multi-reference uploads, and prompt structures that produce on-brand, photorealistic output. Land usable clips efficiently — minimising regenerations through tight prompting and proper reference setup.



AI Image Generation on Higgsfield. Produce statics and end cards using Nano Banana Pro — Meta ads, image variants, layout work. Use Higgsfield's hex codes, Moodboards, and Soul IDs to maintain brand consistency across every output.



Static & Layout Work Across Brand Surfaces. Produce Meta static ads, Amazon A+ Content modules, website image galleries, product page assets, and other brand design work as needed. You'll be expected to deliver design work that reads on-brand without being micromanaged on every layout decision.



Video Editing in CapCut. Assemble generated clips, cut to brief timing, add captions, sound design, and on-screen text. Output ad-ready files for Meta, TikTok, Google, and Amazon paid social.



Project Organisation in Notion, 
 & Locally. Manage your work across 
 (review, feedback, version control) and your desktop (working files, exports, source assets). Strict file naming, organised folder structures, version discipline. Manage your own pipeline without being chased.



Requirements



Daily, demonstrated experience with Higgsfield. Not awareness — actual production work. You should be able to talk through Soul ID training, multi-reference uploads, and which model suits which type of brief.



Strong Nano Banana Pro fluency for image and static generation, including hex code locking and Moodboard usage.

Proven CapCut editing experience for short-form paid social. Speed and clean output matter more than fancy effects.



Static design capability beyond AI generation — you can produce Amazon A+ modules, website image galleries, and Meta statics that read polished and on-brand. Comfortable with layout, hierarchy, and basic graphic design principles.



Disciplined brief execution. When a brief specifies a composition, colour, or detail, you deliver that — not your interpretation of it.




 workflow experience — version uploads, comment management, organised review cycles.



Highly organised desktop workflow — clean folder structures, consistent file naming, no lost assets.



Nuanced brief execution and clean caption writing in British English.



Proven track record producing high-performing creative for eCommerce or DTC brands. Meta ads especially — but cross-channel capability is a plus.



Performance-led thinking. You think about conversion, not just aesthetics.



Speed and ownership — typically 2–3 finished video edits plus 1–2 statics per day, minimal oversight, fast iteration on feedback.



Who This Is Not For



People looking for a relaxed role. This is high output, every day.



Creatives who prioritise aesthetics over performance.



Anyone not already using Higgsfield daily in their production workflow.



People who reinterpret briefs creatively rather than executing what's written.



People who need to be guided step-by-step instead of learning fast and taking ownership.



Slow executors or anyone who can't handle direct feedback and fast turnarounds.



What You'll Gain



A modern AI-first creative stack — Higgsfield, Claude Projects, CapCut, 
.



Cross-channel creative remit — Meta ads, Amazon A+, website, Google, TikTok.



Clear briefs, clear expectations, and the opportunity to grow as our creative team scales.



How to Apply



Subject line: "MSS AI Video & Static Editor — Application"



Include all of the following or your application will not be reviewed:



A short written introduction covering your daily Higgsfield workflow, eCommerce ad creative experience, and why you're a fit for this role.



A portfolio showing:



Higgsfield-generated video clips (UGC-style, product demos, B-roll)



Final edited ads assembled in CapCut



Static ads produced via Nano Banana Pro



Examples of broader design work — Amazon A+ modules, website assets, or similar layout work if you have them



Meta / TikTok ads you've shipped to paid media, with any performance context you can share



Evidence of Higgsfield proficiency — real examples, not screenshots of the dashboard



A short note on your file management and 
 workflow.



Applications missing any of the above will not be considered.
